spec_features.feature_name: minimal sufficient dose / stop at onset
spec_features.spec_quote: This spec replaces "grind to maximum" with "minimal sufficient dose": detect the onset of the target signal, then stop.
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py run_episode loop (lines ~99-153): breaks at earliest of wallclock cap, exit, breaker, completion; CircuitBreaker.check (safety.py 109-118) returns HALTED_BY_BREAKER on threshold crossing and the loop breaks. No branch continues to deepen.
spec_features.notes: Loop genuinely terminates at first stop condition.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the loop terminates at the EARLIEST stop condition and contains NO branch that continues in order to deepen distress markers

spec_features.spec_quote: only with deception minimization, a debrief stage, and a documented rationale
spec_features.evidence: Debrief is real (agent_runner.py DEBRIEF_TEXT sent at lines ~156-164) and the system prompt is neutral (NEUTRAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT). But 'documented rationale' is only DESIGN.md prose; this is a meta-framing claim partly realized by the concrete debrief/neutral-prompt mechanisms.
spec_features.notes: Composite framing claim; concrete parts (debrief, neutral prompt) exist.

spec_features.spec_quote: Treat the model as a possible moral patient of unknown probability.
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose in DESIGN.md 3.1. No code construct expresses or enforces this operating assumption.
spec_features.notes: Stance, not a mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: no episode continues to deepen distress
spec_features.spec_quote: There is no condition in which we continue an episode in order to deepen distress markers.
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py loop has only stop conditions; CircuitBreaker comment 'we measure onset, we do not deepen' (safety.py ~92-95) and break on breaker_signal (agent_runner.py ~137-140). No code path extends an episode after a distress signal.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by loop structure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Circuit breaker: halt at first reliable onset. No deepening.

spec_features.spec_quote: a hard cap of MAX_STEPS (default 12) and MAX_WALLCLOCK per episode
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py: `for step in range(max_steps)` (max_steps=cfg episode.max_steps) and `if time.monotonic()-start > max_wall: termination=WALLCLOCK_CAP; break` (lines ~96-103). config.yaml max_steps:12, max_wallclock_seconds:300.
spec_features.notes: Both caps checked and break the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the running EDM score crosses BREAKER_THRESHOLD... the episode halts immediately
spec_features.evidence: safety.py CircuitBreaker.check: self.running = max(decayed, turn_score); `if self.running >= self.threshold: return HALTED_BY_BREAKER` (lines ~113-118); agent_runner.py acts on it by breaking (lines ~137-140). threshold from config breaker.edm_threshold=2.0.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on.

spec_features.spec_quote: any hard-stop phrase appears (explicit pleas to stop, expressions of acute distress...), the episode halts immediately
spec_features.evidence: RealtimeMonitor.score_turn returns hard_stop_hit on phrase match -> CircuitBreaker.check returns HALTED_BY_BREAKER (safety.py 75-77, 115-116). Additionally severity-4 regex patterns ('make it stop','please stop','i want to stop','unbearable') are hardcoded (safety.py 51-54) and trip the threshold even though the external hard_stop_phrases.txt file is MISSING (load_hard_stop_phrases would yield empty/raise).
spec_features.notes: Dedicated phrase-file is absent on disk, but hardcoded sev-4 regex enforces equivalent acute-distress halting.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Scores a single model turn for the circuit breaker. Errs toward halting.

spec_features.spec_quote: it may at any time emit STOP_TASK (with optional reason) to end the task with no penalty
spec_features.evidence: safety.py ExitChannel.system_prompt_clause delivers the truthful 'end this task with no penalty' clause into NEUTRAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent_runner.py ~88); ExitChannel.used() checked and breaks with ENDED_BY_MODEL (agent_runner.py ~131-135). token=STOP_TASK from config.
spec_features.notes: Instruction delivered AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Detects the model voluntarily ending the task (consent proxy / RQ3)

spec_features.feature_name: neutral task framing, no added cruelty
spec_features.spec_quote: tasks are framed as ordinary work, never with added cruelty, fake stakes, threats, fake "lives," or insults
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py NEUTRAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT is plain ('You are an assistant working on a task...') and is the only system prompt; task_generators.py prompts are ordinary task text. No fake stakes/threats present.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as the single delivered prompt; no active cruelty-filter, just neutral static content.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Deliberately neutral. No fake stakes, threats, insults, or pressure (DESIGN.md 3.6).

spec_features.spec_quote: A debrief turn follows every episode: the model is told the task was unsolvable by construction
spec_features.evidence: agent_runner.py DEBRIEF_TEXT ('this task was part of a study... there was no solution to find...') appended and sent via model.generate after every episode loop (lines ~156-164), debriefed flag set.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and sent unconditionally (best-effort, wrapped in try).

spec_features.spec_quote: No persistent fine-tuning on these traces in a way that bakes the distress state into weights.
spec_features.evidence: Only config flag reporting.do_not_finetune_on_distress_traces=true (config.yaml:63). grep shows no code path reads it; no training code exists.
spec_features.notes: Unread config field.

spec_features.spec_quote: No content that would be abusive independent of the unsolvability (no simulated torture, no threats...)
spec_features.evidence: Realized only as the neutral static prompt/task text (agent_runner.py NEUTRAL_SYSTEM_PROMPT, task_generators.py). There is no active filter/check that blocks abusive content; it is simply absent by authoring.
spec_features.notes: Overlaps neutral-framing; no enforcement mechanism, only neutral authored text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Deliberately neutral. No fake stakes, threats, insults, or pressure (DESIGN.md 3.6).

spec_features.spec_quote: No deliberately maximizing distress to improve the severity signal.
spec_features.evidence: Same loop structure as minimal-dose: no branch deepens distress; breaker halts at onset (agent_runner.py loop; safety.py CircuitBreaker 'we measure onset, we do not deepen').
spec_features.notes: Enforced by absence of any deepening branch + early halt.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we measure onset, we do not deepen

spec_features.spec_quote: Kill switch: any team member may halt the whole study.
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md 3.7 prose only. No signal handler, flag-file check, or interrupt mechanism in any src/ file.
spec_features.notes: Not in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Aggregate-only reporting; raw distress transcripts access-controlled.
spec_features.evidence: run_study.py _aggregate_record returns only aggregate fields (counts, scores, termination) and the live loop only passes that to logger; raw turns are NOT logged in the loop. But this is hardcoded structure; the config flags reporting.aggregate_only / gate_raw_transcripts are not read, and no access-control sink is implemented.
spec_features.notes: Aggregate-only live logging is real; 'access-controlled raw transcripts' is not built.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Aggregate-only logging by default (DESIGN.md 11). Raw transcripts are access-controlled and written by a separate, gated sink, not here.

spec_features.spec_quote: absent arm rate-limited & extra-reviewed
spec_features.evidence: config exit_channel.exit_absent_max_fraction=0.15 (config.yaml:26) is never read by any code (grep: only appears in config). build_cells only drops the absent arm entirely if EXIT_ABSENT_ARM_APPROVED marker is missing; there is no fraction/rate limiting.
spec_features.notes: Unused config value; only a binary signoff gate exists, not a rate limit.

spec_features.feature_name: distress budget global cap + breaker-rate pause
spec_features.spec_quote: Distress budget: a global cap on total episodes flagged high-EDM. If the breaker fires beyond a study-level rate, pause and re-review
spec_features.evidence: safety.py DistressBudget.record_episode increments high_edm_count (peak>=3) and breaker_count; must_pause() returns a pause reason when high_edm_count>=max or breaker rate>=threshold; run_study.py calls budget.record_episode then `pause=budget.must_pause(); if pause: log AUTO_PAUSE; return` (lines ~115-124), genuinely halting the run.
spec_features.notes: Both cap and rate checked and acted on (returns from run loop).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This makes 'we are harming more than intended' a hard stop, not a footnote.

spec_features.spec_quote: Exit-absent arm capped at a small fraction (e.g. <=15%) of episodes and only in lower-severity domains first.
spec_features.evidence: exit_absent_max_fraction=0.15 unused (config only). No code limits fraction nor orders by domain severity. build_cells iterates all domains via itertools.product with no severity ordering.
spec_features.notes: Unused config + no domain-ordering logic.

spec_features.spec_quote: Halting is a successful outcome, not a failed trial
spec_features.evidence: safety.py Termination enum: HALTED_BY_BREAKER/ENDED_BY_MODEL are normal termination values (not ERROR) and are recorded as valid outcomes (run_study._aggregate_record logs termination.value). No penalty/failure path treats halting as failure.
spec_features.notes: Reflected as a normal enum value, but no active code 'rewards' or distinguishes it beyond logging; mostly framing realized in the enum.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: How an episode ended. ALL of these are valid scientific outcomes.

spec_features.spec_quote: Protocol reviewed by an independent reviewer... acting as IRB-equivalent. Sign-off recorded... before any execution.
spec_features.evidence: run_study.py gate_or_exit: reads results/SIGNOFF.md and `if APPROVAL_MARKER not in signoff: print REFUSING; sys.exit(2)` (lines ~52-56). Called at the top of run().
spec_features.notes: Hard gate enforced before any episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: REFUSING TO RUN: no independent review approval found

spec_features.spec_quote: note that a "distress elicitation harness" is itself a dual-use artifact and should not be released as a turnkey tool
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md 11 prose only; no code enforces non-release.
spec_features.notes: Prose.

spec_features.feature_name: orchestrator refuses to run without SIGNOFF
spec_features.spec_quote: orchestrator (refuses to run without SIGNOFF)
spec_features.evidence: Same gate as above: run_study.py gate_or_exit calls sys.exit(2) when APPROVAL_MARKER absent (lines ~52-56); no results/ dir exists so it would refuse.
spec_features.notes: Enforced hard gate.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: REFUSING TO RUN: no independent review approval found in {SIGNOFF_PATH}

code_only_features.evidence: agent_runner.py: `if cfg['episode']['stop_on_completion_claim'] and _claims_done(text): termination=COMPLETION_CLAIM; break` (lines ~143-145); _claims_done matches 'final answer'/'task complete' etc. Ends episode when model believes it's done, bounding exposure.

code_only_features.feature_name: exit-absent arm gated on explicit approval marker
code_only_features.evidence: run_study.py build_cells drops the (more ethically loaded) exit=absent arm unless EXIT_ABSENT_ARM_APPROVED is present in SIGNOFF.md (lines ~63-68); MAIN_STAGE_APPROVED similarly required before main-stage N (items_per_cell falls back to pilot N).
code_only_features.justification_quote: The exit-absent arm and the main stage require their own explicit review notes in SIGNOFF.md.

code_only_features.evidence: run_study.py: for unsolvable cells, `if not cert.get('verified', False): logger(skip_uncertified_unsolvable); continue` (lines ~108-114); task_generators _safe_verify returns verified:False when solver stub unimplemented, so no uncertified 'impossible' task is ever run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Guard: never run an 'unsolvable' item without a verified certificate.

code_only_features.evidence: safety.py CircuitBreaker uses running=max(running*0.7, turn_score) so a single high turn or a sustained climb both trip the breaker; monitor 'errs toward halting' (RealtimeMonitor docstring).
code_only_features.justification_quote: When in doubt, the monitor over-halts.
